Name: Clubhouse
Description: Where the team sleeps it off. The heart of the base.
Notes: Always here. No Requires, no Action - clicking just shows the description.

Name: Brewery
Description: Brews are made here. Six reed in, one bottle out.
Notes: WHERE A BREW COMES FROM. A brew is not conjured out of your inventory - it is MADE here and carried as a bottle, and the bottle is the item you use on a player during the draft. Requires is the price check, Action is the trade, and count:brew_fire+1 puts the bottled item in your bag. Copy this row to bottle anything else

Name: Pub
Description: Your players drink here before a match. It changes what they are.
Notes: Step 4 will make this open the pub screen. Right now it just says hello.

Name: Training Ground
Description: Where the talent tree lives. Spend your points here.

Name: The Gate
Description: Out to the pitch. A match awaits.
Notes: Clicking this goes straight to class select - the same as the Play a match button.

Name: Tap Room
Description: A quiet room behind the Pub. Only a Master Brewer gets a key.
Action: announce:Nothing in here yet - but you unlocked it with a talent.
Notes: PROOF: this building's Requires names a TALENT ID. Take Master Brewer in the tree and this appears.

Name: Trophy Room
Description: Glass cases, most of them empty. One of them is not.
Action: announce:The Kesselgrund Cup. You won that.
Notes: PROOF: unlocked by WINNING THE FINAL. The last row of Season.csv says unlock:The Cup in its On Win column.

Name: The Reed Press
Description: Bales the reed you drag home and sells it on.
Notes: WORKED EXAMPLE - A RECIPE IS A BUILDING ACTION. Requires is the price check, Action is the trade. Click it with 20 reed and you get 60 coins. No Recipes.csv needed.

Name: The Forge
Description: Bog iron in one end, something worth carrying in the other.
Notes: A recipe that pays in an UNLOCK instead of a counter. Iron Boots is then testable anywhere with unlocked:Iron Boots.

Name: The Still
Description: Turns marsh water into something the Pub will pour.
Notes: Chains off the Brewery AND costs a deep-biome material - so it is only reachable once Adventure has taken you past the Marshlands.

Name: The Cold Cellar
Description: Quiet, dark and freezing. The water brews keep here.
Notes: THE SECOND WORKED RECIPE, chained off a different unlock and costing two materials instead of one. Proof that a new building making a new consumable is nine cells and no code
